Every QGenda user has a personal calendar link, no matter which calendar app you use: QGenda → Settings → Calendar Sync → copy the sync URL. Paste it once — it's remembered, and future quarters load with one click.

Show me how to get my link (30 seconds)
1 · Log in at app.qgenda.com

On your dashboard, find My Quick View and click the Sync Calendar button on its right side.

2 · Copy your Subscription URL

Copy the URL in the box, paste it above, done. Leave "Sync as all-day events" unchecked. This link is yours permanently — you only do this once.

If your QGenda syncs to Google Calendar: one click and your shifts load. Tip: in QGenda → Calendar Connections, uncheck "Sync As All Day" so shifts carry exact times.

If a shift has no times, assumehours

If your QGenda syncs to your Outlook / AHS work calendar: sign in once with your work account.

In QGenda: View tab → Export / Calendar Sync → download the .ics file, then drop it here. Works offline, needs no setup.

No QGenda needed — just say it or type it, in plain English: "I worked Saturday 3pm to 1am, Sunday 1am to 7am, and Monday 1pm to 11pm". Dates like 3/2 0700-1900 or the 4th, 7a-7p work too.

No import — enter hours directly in the next step. Quick-fill buttons are available per day.

3 · Daily hours by activity code

Quarter-hour increments (.25 = 15 min). Daily total must equal your paid hours that day. Leave days not worked at zero — they’re treated as not worked.

4 · Sign, generate, send

Sign below, generate the completed DHCS 5293 PDF, then email it to PNPPTimeStudies. Your supervisor’s signature line is left blank for their counter-signature.
